changelog:
Initial release of earnings-analysis skill.

- Automatically analyzes financial reports (earnings, annual, or quarterly reports) by request or when a stock and related keywords are mentioned.
- Extracts and summarizes key financial metrics (revenue, net profit, YoY growth, ROE, cash flow, forecast surprises, and rating changes).
- Provides structured markdown reports including core data, highlights, quality assessment, institution views, and next report date.
- Ensures concise output (600 characters per stock, 300 when batch analysis).
- Does not provide explicit buy/sell advice, only analytical signals.
